lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. i1040gi p. 101, Schedule 1-A, Part II, "If you are married, you must file a joint return with your spouse to claim this deduction". The case is married filing separately (f1040.status mfs), so Part II does not apply and every line of it is $0 (the owner's reading that each printed line of Parts II to V is $0 unless its part applies); the model filled the part's phase-out lines anyway. [dropped]
